verdict.rationale: Fireworks documents an open-source benchmarking tool explicitly for measuring throughput/latency under load, plus latency-oriented features (Fast variant, speculative decoding, on-demand for lower latency), which partially satisfies the 'load-testing guide' half of the story. However, there are no published tokens-per-second numbers, latency benchmarks, or third-party performance comparisons in the evidence pack. Missing for 10: actual published TPS/latency figures, comparative benchmark results, independent load-test corroboration.
